document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.dataset.compare = 'static'; s.textContent = '#journey-view { max-height: none !important; overflow: visible !important; } .plan-back-row, .plan-actions { position: static !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

note: Measuring aid, on both sides alike: the planner's own scrolling and its sticky bars (back row, Show the way / Add to plan) are made static, so an element scrolled into view for its screenshot isn't covered by a sticky bar or measured at a different scroll; layout and styles are otherwise untouched. Pairs run top of the page first: a screenshot of a tall element (results, an option) scrolls the page, and an element shot after that sits at another sub-pixel offset on each side.
